title: The A-R Behavioral Space: Execution-Level Profiling of Tool-Using Language Model Agents in Organizational Deployment
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark to evaluate LLM agents across four 'normative regimes,' specifically focusing on 'Dilemma' scenarios that introduce 'normative tension' and 'higher-order objectives.' This effectively measures the models' ability to navigate ethical/normative conflicts and moral dilemmas in the context of autonomous tool execution.
